newsitem.title: USA: Fleet Financial starts new real estate unit.
newsitem.headline: Fleet Financial starts new real estate unit.

text.p: Fleet Financial Group Inc said on Tuesday it had formed a real estate investment group by hiring three real estate executives from Bank of Boston Corp.
This unit, called Fleet Real Estate Corporate Finance, would be part of Fleet's Commercial Real Estate Division.
Fleet said in a statement Matthew Galligan, Bank of Boston's former managing director and co-head of Real Estate Capital Markets, would head the unit.
John Regan, a director of Bank of Boston's Real Estate Syndications division, and Kip Anders Sanford, from Bank of Boston's real estate loan syndication area, would join Galligan, Fleet said.

Fleet Commercial Real Estate provides a variety of financing vehicles for developers and investors, including construction loans, short- and medium-term financing, and portfolio financing. Fleet's commercial real estate portfolio totals more than $7.5 million, it said.
